senses.def: the firing of a gun, or the sound it makes
senses.ex: We heard a gunshot in the middle of the night.
senses.exPt: Ouvimos um tiro no meio da noite.

senses.def: to flow out suddenly and in large amounts
senses.ex: Water gushed from the broken pipe all over the floor.
senses.exPt: A água jorrou do cano quebrado pelo chão todo.

senses.def: to praise something with too much enthusiasm
senses.ex: She gushed about her new boyfriend all evening.
senses.exPt: Ela passou a noite toda se derretendo pelo namorado novo.

senses.def: a sudden large flow of liquid or air
senses.ex: A gush of cold water came out of the tap.
senses.exPt: Saiu um jorro de água fria da torneira.

senses.def: praising someone or something too much
senses.ex: The film received gushing reviews from the critics.
senses.exPt: O filme recebeu resenhas efusivas da crítica.

senses.def: flowing out quickly and in large amounts
senses.ex: We heard the sound of gushing water from the broken pipe.
senses.exPt: Ouvimos o barulho da água jorrando do cano estourado.

senses.def: with too much praise or emotion
senses.ex: She spoke gushingly about her new boyfriend to everyone.
senses.exPt: Ela falava efusivamente do namorado novo para todo mundo.

senses.def: great energy and enjoyment in doing something
senses.ex: The children sang the song with great gusto.
senses.exPt: As crianças cantaram a música com muito entusiasmo.

senses.def: the courage to do something difficult
senses.ex: It takes guts to quit a good job and start again.
senses.exPt: É preciso coragem para largar um bom emprego e recomeçar.

senses.def: the organs inside the body of a person or animal
senses.ex: The fishermen cleaned out the guts of the fish.
senses.exPt: Os pescadores tiraram as tripas do peixe.

senses.def: brave and determined
senses.ex: It was a gutsy decision to quit her job and start a business.
senses.exPt: Foi uma decisão corajosa largar o emprego e abrir um negócio.

senses.def: an informal word for a man
senses.ex: Who's that guy talking to your sister?
senses.exPt: Quem é aquele cara conversando com a sua irmã?

senses.def: guys: an informal way to talk to a group of people
senses.ex: Hi guys, sorry I'm late again!
senses.exPt: Oi, pessoal, desculpa o atraso de novo!

senses.def: a place with machines where people go to exercise
senses.ex: I go to the gym three times a week.
senses.exPt: Eu vou à academia três vezes por semana.

senses.def: a large room in a school for sports and games
senses.ex: The school basketball game is in the gym tonight.
senses.exPt: O jogo de basquete da escola é no ginásio hoje à noite.

senses.def: connected with gymnastics
senses.ex: The show included some amazing gymnastic moves.
senses.exPt: O show teve alguns movimentos de ginástica incríveis.

senses.def: a sport with exercises that show strength and balance
senses.ex: She has been doing gymnastics since she was five.
senses.exPt: Ela faz ginástica desde os cinco anos.

senses.def: a member of the Roma people; often considered offensive
senses.ex: A gypsy woman offered to read my palm at the fair.
senses.exPt: Uma cigana se ofereceu para ler minha mão na feira.
